headline: Agi Infra holds its annual general meeting for shareholders
hook: Routine AGM proceedings concluded at Agi Infra
summary: Agi Infra Limited has announced the completion of its annual general meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company informed the stock exchange regarding the proceedings of the meeting. Such procedural filings are standard corporate governance requirements for listed entities. Retail investors holding the stock should note this is a routine regulatory update with no direct financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate update with no immediate impact on share price
